title: Snake
description: The classic game, reimagined. Eat, grow, survive.
longDescription: Guide your snake to eat food and grow as long as possible without hitting walls or yourself. Choose from multiple difficulty levels, grid sizes, and snake skins. Compete for the top spot on the leaderboard — and watch out for power-ups.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Classic strategy across 3 board sizes. Beat an unbeatable AI — or a friend.
longDescription: Three board sizes (Classic 3×3, Extended 5×5, Gomoku 15×15), four AI difficulty levels — including a full minimax Unbeatable mode — plus series play, power-ups, and turn timers. 28 unique player avatars. Track your match history and player stats across every session.

title: Nexus
description: Guess the hidden category from 5 mystery clues. The fewer hints you need, the higher you score.
longDescription: Nexus reveals clue words one at a time — each one pointing toward a hidden category. Guess correctly on the first hint for the maximum score of 500 points. Six modes including Daily challenge, Streak, and Time Attack keep gameplay fresh.
